acceptanceCovered: /login renders the SAA 2025 design with VN default locale -- proof: resolveLocale defaults vi (locale.ts), login page reads cookie via getRequestLocale; route smoke 10/10 shows VN copy + footer; screenshots in evidence/

Google OAuth starts same-tab via Supabase signInWithOAuth and /auth/callback exchanges the code -- proof: login-page-client.tsx handleLogin calls signInWithOAuth with redirectTo origin/auth/callback; callback/route.ts calls exchangeCodeForSession in try/catch (live OAuth blocked, accepted)

Unauthenticated /todo redirects to /login and authenticated /login redirects to /todo -- proof: decide-route-redirect.ts + 7 unit tests incl. nested and lookalike /todos; proxy.ts applies it with redirectWithCookies; smoke: /todo 307 to /login with and without stale cookie

OAuth failure shows the localized error directly under the login button via error=oauth param -- proof: resolveCallbackRedirect fixed target /login?error=oauth for provider error, missing code, failed exchange; has-login-error.ts matches exact value only; message comes from dictionary (no param echo, no XSS)

Language selector switches vi/en instantly and persists the NEXT_LOCALE cookie -- proof: handleLocaleChange sets state immediately then setLocaleAction (whitelisted via resolveLocale, httpOnly, lax, 1y)
/todo shows name email avatar and logout returns to /login -- proof: todo/page.tsx uses getUser() (server-verified) + getDisplayUser fallbacks; signOutAction logs error and always redirects to /login
npm test tsc eslint and build all exit 0 -- proof: temper-results.json and temper-run-v2-* record exit 0 for npm test (vitest), tsc --noEmit, eslint, npm run lint, npm run build

eslint.config.mjs globalIgnores excludes .claude/** only; src still linted (npm run lint exit 0)
next.config.ts images.remotePatterns: https googleusercontent hosts only; no wildcard host
root scaffold home page / untouched: decideRouteRedirect passes / through for both auth states; build shows it static
callback error paths: no code, provider error, exchange error, thrown exception all map to fixed /login?error=oauth (no open redirect)
proxy cookie propagation: redirectWithCookies copies refreshed Set-Cookie from pass-through response; getClaims (JWT verified) not getSession; network throw degrades to unauthenticated

findings.summary: Avatar URL from user-editable user_metadata was accepted for any http(s) host, crashing next/image on /todo (self-inflicted). RESOLVED: readAvatarUrl now requires https + *.googleusercontent.com, 3 rejection tests added, suite 40/40.
getSupabaseEnv() throws outside try/catch; missing env gives opaque 500 on every proxied route (fail-closed). Move inside try or document.
Provider error code is not logged, only a generic failure; console.warn the providerError (not echoed to user).
